body: Maybe it's worth noting that Github is not the only mean to create an account and we also support Google and vanilla signups. I fear that some people might be intimidated by the fact it requires strictly a github account. WDYT?

body:
Maybe it could be better to have a list of next steps:

```markdown
What to do next:
 - get a feel of the magic of react-instantsearch by building your first implementation using our getting started (15 minutes)
 - learn how to install and dig into the concepts by following the guide: [next is how to install](/guide/Install.html)
 - see all the possibilities by reading in our [widgets documentation](/widgets/)
```

Something like that, even though it's not that well formulated :)
